parsed.basis: Ropažu novads, a largely rural and suburban municipality east of Riga, operates under Latvia's national regime for a transgender visitor. Same-sex conduct is not criminalised, there is no trans-specific criminal offence, and identity documents are changed in practice on a medical certificate following a 2008 Supreme Court ruling, though nonbinary recognition is unavailable and no statute defines legal gender recognition. Anti-discrimination protection documented covers sexual orientation in employment, with no documented gender-identity provision, and enforcement of hate-motivated offences has documented shortcomings, including a 2024 European Court finding after an unprosecuted homophobic attack in Riga. No region-specific information distinguishes this municipality from the national picture.
